propositions: rebar comment silently accepts flag-like tokens (e.g. `--body-file`, `--body`) as the positional body argument instead of rejecting them, causing the intended content to be discarded while exit code remains 0
surplus positional arguments after a flag-like token are dropped by `args[:min_args]` slicing, compounding the silent loss of comment data
the observed failure has recurred across two independent sessions with stored 11-byte and 6-byte comment stubs, demonstrating a systematic usability footgun
positional-body commands (comment, create, edit, session-log, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands) lack a guard to reject arguments beginning with `-` unless explicitly escaped with `--`
the `--` escape hatch must be implemented and tested to permit legitimate body values that begin with a dash
no `--body-file` option was added; instead, shell substitution `$(cat file)` idiom is documented as the workaround for long bodies
